title: Balkrishna Industries shares rise 8% after Q1FY27 results, 200% final dividend: Should you buy?
text: Balkrishna Industries shares rose over 10% after strong Q1 FY27 earnings, with a net profit increase of 56.4% YoY to ₹451 crore. Revenue grew 25% YoY to ₹3,455 crore. The board declared a first interim dividend of ₹4 per share with August 4 as the record date.

title: Sensex, Nifty 50 rise, but mid, small-caps falter; rising US bond yields keep investors cautious
text: The Sensex rose 274 points, or 0.35%, to end at 77,928, while the Nifty 50 settled at 24,317, up 67 points, or 0.28%. However, the Nifty Midcap 100 index slipped 0.35%, and the Smallcap 100 index ended 0.56% lower.

title: South Korean KOSPI falls 38.50% after hitting record high on 22 June 2026; here's why

title: Vedanta Aluminium Metal Q1 Results: Net profit jumps 34% QoQ to ₹5,629 crore; revenue up 12%
text: Vedanta Aluminium Metal Q1 Results: Vedanta Aluminium posted a net profit of ₹5,629 crore in Q1 FY27, a 33.8% increase. Revenue grew to ₹21,393 crore, while EBITDA rose 23.3%. The company also set a record in aluminium production, reinforcing its position as India's largest producer.
